name_zh: 咖啡仪式/原住民领袖：非洲口述传统治理与咖啡外交
name_en: Coffee Ceremony/Indigenous Leaders: African Oral Tradition Governance & Coffee Diplomacy
description_zh: 埃塞俄比亚咖啡起源地(卡法森林)，咖啡仪式(Buna)为核心社会治理技术：烘焙/研磨/煮制三轮(阿沃尔/托纳/巴雷卡)/长者主持/社区议事/冲突调解/婚姻协商/联盟缔结。奥罗莫/锡达马/耶姆等族群长者(Gadaa 制度/长者会议)以咖啡仪式编码生态知识/族谱/法律/战争记忆。体现 M185 非洲口述传统治理——以"咖啡仪式即议会+长者即法官+口述即宪法+咖啡即外交"四位一体，在无文字/弱国家/强宗族社会中实现秩序与共识。
description_en: Ethiopia as coffee origin (Kaffa forest), coffee ceremony (Buna) as core social governance tech: roasting/grinding/brewing three rounds (Abol/Tona/Baraka)/elders preside/community deliberation/conflict mediation/marriage negotiation/alliance making. Oromo/Sidama/Yem elders (Gadaa system/council of elders) encode ecological knowledge/genealogy/law/war memory via coffee ceremony. Exemplifies M185 African Oral Tradition Governance—quaternity of 'coffee ceremony as parliament + elders as judges + oral as constitution + coffee as diplomacy' achieving order & consensus in non-literate/weak-state/strong-clan societies.
reason_zh: 埃塞俄比亚咖啡仪式非单纯饮食，而是"仪式即议会+长者即法官+口述即宪法"三位一体治理操作系统。Gadaa 制度(奥罗莫 8 年轮值/长者会议/权力交接仪式)以咖啡仪式编码权力交接/冲突解决/资源分配。M185 区隔于 M154 梦境时间(澳洲)、M148 毛利共识(新西兰)、M146 乌班图(南非)，核心在于"咖啡仪式即治理算法+口述传统即法律编码+长者权威即制度保障"的非洲口述治理范式。
reason_en: Ethiopian coffee ceremony not mere dining but 'ceremony as parliament + elders as judges + oral as constitution' trinity governance OS. Gadaa system (Oromo 8-year rotation/elders council/power transfer ritual) encodes power transfer/conflict resolution/resource allocation via coffee ceremony. M185 distinct from M154 Dreamtime (Australia), M148 Māori Consensus (NZ), M146 Ubuntu (SA), core: 'coffee ceremony as governance algorithm + oral tradition as legal code + elder authority as institutional guarantee' African oral governance paradigm.
steps_zh: 咖啡仪式即议会：三轮煮制(阿沃尔/托纳/巴雷卡)对应议事阶段/信息公开/决策确认，长者主持社区公议
长者即法官：Gadaa 长者会议/族谱权威/习法记忆，冲突调解/婚姻协商/土地分配/血亲复仇终结
口述即宪法：族谱/习法/生态知识/战争记忆编码于咖啡仪式/歌曲/诗歌/谚语，代际传承零文字
咖啡即外交：咖啡贸易/礼品赠予/联盟缔结/和平缔结/跨族群通婚，咖啡豆即信任货币
现代传承与制度化：咖啡仪式入选非遗/旅游体验/品牌出口/现代法律吸纳习法/长者参与地方治理
steps_en: Coffee ceremony as parliament: three brewing rounds (Abol/Tona/Baraka) correspond to deliberation phases/info disclosure/decision confirmation, elders preside community assembly
Elders as judges: Gadaa elders council/genealogical authority/customary law memory, conflict mediation/marriage negotiation/land allocation/blood feud termination
Oral as constitution: genealogy/customary law/ecological knowledge/war memory encoded in coffee ceremony/songs/poems/proverbs, intergenerational transmission zero-text
Coffee as diplomacy: coffee trade/gift giving/alliance making/peace treaties/inter-clan marriages, coffee beans as trust currency
Modern transmission & institutionalization: coffee ceremony UNESCO ICH/tourism experience/brand export/modern law absorbs customary law/elders participate local governance
expected_zh: 以"咖啡仪式即议会+长者即法官+口述即宪法+咖啡即外交"四位一体，在无文字/弱国家/强宗族社会中实现秩序与共识，为非洲口述传统社会提供治理范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'coffee ceremony as parliament + elders as judges + oral as constitution + coffee as diplomacy' achieves order & consensus in non-literate/weak-state/strong-clan societies, providing governance paradigm for African oral tradition societies.
case_zh: Gadaa 制度 2016 非遗/咖啡仪式 2023 非遗/奥罗莫 4000 万+人口/每 8 年权力交接/长者会议零成本冲突解决/咖啡出口 $10 亿+/年，口述治理活化石。
case_en: Gadaa system 2016 UNESCO ICH/coffee ceremony 2023 ICH/Oromo 40M+ population/8-year power rotation/elders council zero-cost conflict resolution/coffee exports $1B+/yr, living fossil of oral governance.
